title_zh: 保留短剧的讽刺结尾并删去无关段落

scenario.label_zh: 保留短剧的讽刺结尾并删去无关段落
scenario.goal_zh: 解释人物结局与主张的反差，并约定保留该结尾、删除无关家族背景

context_zh: 学生向写作教师征求原创短剧结尾的修改意见，人物和事件均为虚构。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: Is it too obvious that the mayor, who bans all music, ends up asking the band for help?

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: No. It's ironic that the person who wanted silence needs the musicians to bring people together.

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: Ironically, the ban also made the band more popular. I was thinking of adding a speech explaining that.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: The audience can see the irony already. Let the mayor quietly ask for one song instead.

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: What about the page describing his grandfather's bakery?

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: It's irrelevant to this ending. Nothing in the scene depends on the bakery.

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: Then I'll cut that page and keep the request for a song. The audience can make the connection.
